question: Who was our first Prime Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• He served as Prime Minister from **15 August 1947** until his death on **27 May 1964**.
 
• Nehru was a central figure in Indian politics both before and after independence.
